### Pass frontmatter variables to styles and scripts with define:vars Source: https://github.com/withastro/docs/blob/main/src/content/docs/en/reference/directives-reference.mdx Passes JSON-serializable variables from component frontmatter into ``` -------------------------------- ### Define CSS variables in Astro style tag Source: https://github.com/withastro/docs/blob/main/src/content/docs/en/tutorial/2-pages/4.mdx Pass frontmatter variables into the component's style block using define:vars and reference them with var(). ```astro ``` -------------------------------- ### `getStaticPaths()` Source: https://github.com/withastro/docs/blob/main/src/content/docs/en/reference/routing-reference.mdx **Type:** `(options: GetStaticPathsOptions) => Promise | GetStaticPathsResult`
A function to generate multiple, prerendered page routes from a single `.astro` page component with one or more [parameters](#params) in its file path. Use this for routes that will be created at build time, also known as static site building. The `getStaticPaths()` function must return an array of objects to determine which URL paths will be prerendered by Astro. Each object must include a `params` object, to specify route paths. The object may optionally contain a `props` object with [data to be passed](#data-passing-with-props) to each page template. `getStaticPaths()` can also be used in static file endpoints for [dynamic routing](/en/guides/endpoints/#params-and-dynamic-routing). :::tip When using TypeScript, use the [`GetStaticPaths`](/en/guides/typescript/#infer-getstaticpaths-types) type utility to ensure type-safe access of your `params` and `props`. ::: :::caution The `getStaticPaths()` function executes in its own isolated scope once, before any page loads. Therefore you can't reference anything from its parent scope, other than file imports. The compiler will warn you if you break this requirement. ::: -------------------------------- ### Passing server-generated image src to client script using getImage() Source: https://github.com/withastro/docs/blob/main/src/content/docs/en/reference/errors/get-image-not-used-on-server.mdx Call getImage() in Astro frontmatter during server rendering, then pass the optimized image src to client-side scripts via define:vars. ```astro --- import { getImage } from "astro:assets"; import myImage from "../assets/my_image.png"; const optimizedImage = await getImage({ src: myImage, width: 300 }); --- ``` -------------------------------- ### Import statements > TypeScript Source: https://github.com/withastro/docs/blob/main/src/content/docs/en/guides/imports.mdx Astro includes built-in support for [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/). You can import `.ts` and `.tsx` files directly in your Astro project, and even write TypeScript code directly inside your [Astro component script](/en/basics/astro-components/#the-component-script) and any [script tags](/en/guides/client-side-scripts/). **Astro doesn't perform any type checking itself.** Type checking should be taken care of outside of Astro, either by your IDE or through a separate script. For type checking Astro files, the [`astro check` command](/en/reference/cli-reference/#astro-check) is provided. :::note[TypeScript and file extensions] Per [TypeScript's module resolution rules](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/module-resolution.html), `.ts` and `.tsx` file extensions should not be used when importing TypeScript files. Instead, either use `.js`/`.jsx` file extensions or completely omit the file extension. ::: Read more about [TypeScript support in Astro](/en/guides/typescript/).
